hints.title: Continuous Alphabetical Rule
hints.text: Two adjacent characters are continuous in the alphabet if ord(s[i]) - ord(s[i - 1]) == 1.

hints.title: Streak Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the current run length of continuous characters. When the continuity condition holds, increment length by 1, otherwise reset to 1.

hints.title: Maximum Streak Accumulation
hints.text: Update the maximum length seen across all indices during a single forward pass.

hints.title: Linear Alphabetical Continuity Pass Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass comparing adjacent ASCII values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) substrings results in quadratic execution time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory tracking current and global maximum counters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes consecutive difference pattern and tracks length in single pass.
